lesson.beat.cover.body2: First, one whole life in half a minute. Then a hike, and a girl with two paths.
lesson.beat.life.heading: Many paths. Here’s one.
lesson.beat.life.alt: One life grows along an age line from birth to {end}, one fork at a time, with gray lines leaving every fork for the choices {name} didn’t make. Luck lifts the path and setbacks drop it. Light green paths carry on past {end}.
lesson.beat.life.altEnd: After the story you can change one of {name}’s choices and watch a different life grow from that fork, with the real path still there behind it.
lesson.beat.adds.heading: Choices add up.
lesson.beat.adds.body1: Choir led to guitar, guitar to a band, the band to a song. Luck lifted Sam’s path. A hard year pushed it down. Not everything was his to choose. Now let’s look at choices over just a few days.
